source_selection: canonical first frozen source and first frozen FIT donor per endpoint; no response selection or replacement
direction: delta=donor-source in float64; exact computed all-zero check first; nonzero norm finite/positive; v=delta/norm in float64, shared by FD and AD dot

representability.predicate: all arrays finite AND any(z_plus!=z) AND any(z_minus!=z) AND any(z_plus!=z_minus)
representability.comparison: exact computed numerical equality,signed zeros equal; whole-vector any,not every coordinate
representability.unrepresentable: if any of the three any predicates false => UNRESOLVED_UNREPRESENTABLE_STEP; no plus/minus model call, never fabricated values
representability.unchanged_individual_coordinates: allowed; zeros in direction/unchanged coordinates alone do not fail
representability.finite_failure: evaluated mandatory norm/vector/point nonfinite => INVALID_NUMERIC and STOP

classification_order: exact all-zero delta => TRIVIAL_ZERO_DISPLACEMENT,no division or perturbation calls
nonzero nonrepresentable whole-vector points => UNRESOLVED_UNREPRESENTABLE_STEP,no perturbation calls
any computed exact preactivation zero or changed computed region among source/plus/minus => UNRESOLVED_KINK_OR_CROSS_REGION
smooth_eligibility: all evaluated required values finite; representability true; same computed ternary regions at source/plus/minus, no computed zero units; not certified real-arithmetic smoothness
group_acceptance: all mandatory chain_AD checks pass; any actually eligible FD mismatch or INVALID_NUMERIC STOP; non-smooth,unrepresentable,trivial states do not block fixed-AD main panel
coverage: all120 planned directions and40 groups retained, expected/attempted/completed/state counts; stopped prefixes use NOT_EXECUTED_AFTER_STOP metadata,not fake classification; overall zero eligible FD => NO_ELIGIBLE_FD_NOT_A_PASS,not automatic study STOP
